units.source_text: 担任记录的少女通知说，快到下午四点的封盘时间了，名人却仿佛没有听见。

en.t: The girl in charge of keeping the record announced that it was almost four in the afternoon, the time to seal the move, but the Master seemed not to have heard.

units.source_text: 少女稍微向名人探出身子，在踌躇的时候，七段替代少女说：

en.t: The girl leaned slightly toward the Master, and as she hesitated, the seventh-dan player spoke in her place:
